Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 :GLOBAL.dup_contract := '';
 :GLOBAL.no_contract := '';
 IF :control_block.contract_id IS NOT NULL 
 THEN -- Added by Kishore on 04/06/2011. SCR 17987
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUBSTR(company, 1, 28)
 ,center_id
 INTO :control_block.company
 ,:control_block.center_id
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND 
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id , :control_block.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND -- SOUKUM 06192018 MLT-248
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 --v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE + 365) AND --IM 6960 
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:control_block.chapter_id,eff_date ,term_date ,sysdate) = 'Y' AND
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM batch_inputs
 WHERE chapter_id= contracts.chapter_id AND 
 contract_id = contracts.contract_id AND 
 ROWNUM = 1
 ) AND 
 ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.dup_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1060');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.no_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF; -- Added by Kishore on 04/06/2011. SCR 17987
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 lv_orderBy VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK = 'BATCH' THEN
 :GLOBAL.batch_COUNT := NULL;
 lv_orderBy := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BATCH', ORDER_BY);
 
 IF INSTR(lv_orderBy, 'ASC') > 0 THEN
 lv_orderBy := 'TO_DATE(SUBSTR(batch_inputs.batch_id, 0, 6), ''MMDDYY'') DESC';
 ELSE
 lv_orderBy := 'TO_DATE(SUBSTR(batch_inputs.batch_id, 0, 6), ''MMDDYY'') ASC';
 END IF;
 
 GO_BLOCK('BATCH');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BATCH', ORDER_BY, lv_orderBy);
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :batch.s_arrow := '>';
 END IF;
 
END;

Block.Name: BATCH
Block.WhereClause:
where batch_inputs.contract_id = nvl(:control_block.contract_id, batch_inputs.contract_id)
 and batch_inputs.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 /* -- Added by Kishore on 08/26/2015. IM 89 */
 and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id, insert_dats)) between
 :control_block.from_date and :control_block.to_date
 and batch_inputs.contract_id in
 (select c.contract_id
 from contracts c, rgt_contract_chapters rcc
 where c.contract_id = rcc.contract_id
 and c.contract_type = 'RG'
 and rcc.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id 
 and c.contract_id = nvl(:control_block.contract_id, batch_inputs.contract_id))
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from units u
 where u.batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and u.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and u.contract_id =
 nvl(:control_block.contract_id, u.contract_id)
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from utrs r
 where r.unit_id = u.unit_id
 and trunc(r.coll_date) = u.coll_date
 and r.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and test_id in
 (select test_id
 from valid_tests
 where test_group not in ('CNFRM', 'SUPP'))
 and ((r.result_status_1 is not null and
 r.extract_date is null) or exists
 (select 'x'
 from rgt_interim_results i
 where i.unit_id = r.unit_id
 and i.coll_date = r.coll_date
 and i.contract_id =
 nvl(:control_block.contract_id,
 i.contract_id)
 and i.chapter_id = r.chapter_id
 and i.batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and i.test_id = r.test_id
 and i.test_seq_no = r.test_seq_no
 and i.result_code is not null))))

PROCEDURE call_another_program (p_prog_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'lname'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CONT_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :control_block.contract_id);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 call_form( lower(p_prog_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;
